associations.detail: The canonical 64-modular seed has only 13 nonzero correlation defects, but the current single-bit q/s packet basis is not sparse in effect. On the frontier seed, a one-packet move changes a median of 51 of the 166 nonzero lag slots and as many as 83.
associations.implication: A CA written directly on the present packet basis will look local in syntax but nonlocal in effect.

associations.association: The frontier seed is frozen in the current radius-2 packet neighborhood
associations.detail: The shared objective at the canonical seed is support_size=13, l1=2880, max_abs=512. Exhaustive one-packet search over 334 packets found 0 improving moves, 1 neutral symmetry move, and 333 worsening moves. Exhaustive two-packet search over 55,611 pairs also found 0 improving moves and only 1 neutral symmetry pair.
associations.implication: Any viable CA must either coordinate neutral or worsening steps or replace the packet basis before rule design matters.

associations.association: Locality has to live on a derived influence graph
associations.detail: The natural local object is not the raw q or s index. It is the sparse bipartite graph linking defect cells to packets with concentrated delta fingerprints.
associations.implication: A graph CA over defect-packet influences is more defensible than a 1D or 2D CA over raw sequence positions.

associations.association: Toric-code and LDPC decoder analogies are useful but incomplete
associations.detail: Syndrome-decoder CA work succeeds because the operative state is a local defect field with bounded-degree interactions. Here the defect support is sparse, but the current single-bit packets have broad lag splash.
associations.implication: Import defect aging, local voting, cluster merging, and collective flips, but do not assume the raw q/s coordinates already provide honest geometry.

associations.association: LABS is the closest adjacent optimization landscape
associations.detail: The q/s objective is built from aperiodic autocorrelation residues, so low-autocorrelation binary sequence work, warning propagation, and local-optima network analyses are more relevant than generic CA-for-optimization papers.
associations.implication: Lag residues should be treated as side information or auxiliary fields even if actuation remains in q/s packet space.

associations.association: Generic energy minimization is already crowded
associations.detail: Annealing, simulated quantum annealing, QAOA-style Hadamard search, Douglas-Rachford feasibility methods, and SAT+CAS already cover global objective search or structured exact search around Hadamard problems.
associations.implication: The CA only has a defensible niche if move selection and state evolution stay local, seed-specific, and representation-controlled.

associations.detail: Without memory, refractory timers, momentum, or cluster labels, a CA on the present frontier reduces to frozen weighted bit-flip or greedy local search because no improving radius-1 or radius-2 moves exist.
associations.implication: Hidden local state is a core mechanism, not decoration.

associations.association: Composite packets are the missing abstraction
associations.detail: Single q-bit or s-bit flips are too global. The likely actuator is a short composite packet whose far-field lag effects cancel so its support concentrates on a small defect neighborhood.
associations.implication: The first serious experiment is packet-library discovery, not rule-table tuning.

associations.detail: If the CA gains only after re-entering Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, or other structured families, or after invoking exact micro-solvers on tiny familiar subproblems, the contribution becomes optimizer-over-known-family rather than a new local dynamic.
associations.implication: Every promising result needs an explicit family-leakage and hybridization audit.

associations.association: The canonical seed is harsher than perturbed near-solutions
associations.detail: A quick matched sanity check at budget 80 from the canonical frontier seed left greedy and simulated annealing at the seed objective, while tabu and stochastic hillclimb only explored worse states before returning the original best score.
associations.implication: Success on lightly perturbed seeds would not answer the actual bottleneck.

forced_bridges.from: Sweep and Harrington-style toric-code CA decoders
forced_bridges.to: q/s packet CA on the 64-modular seed
forced_bridges.mechanism: Represent each nonzero lag defect as a charge on a defect-packet graph, add age and direction memory, and let charges pull on nearby composite packets until opposite-sign defects meet and annihilate.

forced_bridges.from: Weighted and collective bit-flip decoders for LDPC and quantum LDPC codes
forced_bridges.mechanism: Replace single packet decisions with neighborhood-approved collective packet bursts triggered by concentrated syndrome disagreement rather than by direct global score ranking.

forced_bridges.from: Warning propagation on low-autocorrelation binary sequences
forced_bridges.mechanism: Use lag-residue cavity fields as side-channel potentials on packet nodes while keeping the actual actuation and accounting in the same q/s packet library.

forced_bridges.from: Graph cellular automata and graph NCA
forced_bridges.mechanism: Run permutation-equivariant local rules on a sparse graph whose edges are defined by exact delta support, so locality is topological rather than tied to raw sequence position.

forced_bridges.from: Nonequilibrium Monte Carlo and unfreezing heuristics
forced_bridges.to: barrier crossing on the canonical seed
forced_bridges.mechanism: Permit short, bounded local avalanches when a neighborhood stagnates, using local activation energy and refractory state instead of a global temperature.
Treat packet firings as short-lived excitations that emit inhibitory wakes, preventing immediate reversal and encouraging defect fronts to move instead of oscillate.

forced_bridges.to: tiny exact repairs around dense defect clusters
forced_bridges.mechanism: When a small defect cluster becomes locally isolated, hand it to a bounded exact micro-solver chosen by the CA and return the repaired patch to the local dynamic.
Use local alternating projections only on small defect neighborhoods as a reset operator, not as the main search dynamic, to avoid becoming a global feasibility solver.

anomaly_results.constraint: Monotone updates only: reject any step that worsens support_size or lexicographic score.
anomaly_results.prediction: The CA dies immediately on the canonical seed because there are no improving 1-packet or 2-packet moves in the current basis.
anomaly_results.implication: Any viable CA needs bounded worsening pulses, neutral drift, or a better packet basis.

anomaly_results.constraint: Strict locality interpreted as raw q/s index radius-1 neighborhoods.
anomaly_results.prediction: The method is fake-local because a typical packet flip perturbs about 51 lag coefficients and up to 83.
anomaly_results.implication: Locality must be defined on a learned or derived influence graph, not on raw index adjacency.

anomaly_results.constraint: No latent state beyond current defect magnitudes.
anomaly_results.prediction: Updates collapse into greedy or weighted bit-flip heuristics and inherit the frozen frontier.
anomaly_results.implication: Include timers, momentum, defect ancestry, or cluster labels.

anomaly_results.prediction: Oscillation and defect diffusion become likely because many packets will chase the same sparse defects simultaneously.
anomaly_results.implication: Prefer asynchronous local auctions or substep schedules.

anomaly_results.constraint: Composite packets restricted to low-splash delta fingerprints.
anomaly_results.prediction: True locality becomes plausible even if packet count grows, because each retained action can be keyed to a small defect neighborhood.
anomaly_results.implication: This is the most promising path to a non-fake-local H1.

anomaly_results.constraint: Seed replaced by lightly perturbed noncanonical near-solutions.
anomaly_results.prediction: Improving local moves will likely reappear, making both CA and non-CA methods look stronger than they are on the real bottleneck.
anomaly_results.implication: Do not infer success on the canonical seed from easier perturbed seeds.

anomaly_results.constraint: Allow tiny local exact micro-solvers on isolated defect clusters.
anomaly_results.prediction: Performance may jump sharply, but the method becomes a CA-guided hybrid rather than a pure CA.
anomaly_results.implication: Report it as scheduler-plus-microsolver if used.

anomaly_results.constraint: Enforce permutation-equivariant graph rules with no absolute packet IDs.
anomaly_results.prediction: If performance survives, the CA is using real defect topology; if it collapses, the rule was overfitting absolute positions in the canonical seed.
anomaly_results.implication: This is a strong anti-cheating audit for H1.

steering_directions.direction: Discover an anti-splash composite packet library before designing the CA
steering_directions.rationale: The current single-bit packet basis is globally disruptive and frozen through radius 2, so no local rule can rescue it by scheduling alone.
steering_directions.first_step: Enumerate symmetry-safe 2-, 4-, and run-boundary packet composites, compute exact delta fingerprints, and keep only packets with small changed-lag support plus some frontier-improving or frontier-neutral behavior.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The retained library drives median changed-lag count far below the current approximately 51 and exposes at least a small improving neighborhood on the canonical seed.

steering_directions.direction: Build a bipartite defect-packet graph CA with local auctions
steering_directions.rationale: Locality is more defensible on an influence graph where defect cells message only the packets that touch them strongly.
steering_directions.first_step: Construct a sparse bipartite graph from exact delta tables, let defects emit signed votes, let packet nodes aggregate neighborhood votes plus refractory state, and execute only locally winning packets asynchronously.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The CA reaches regions that matched greedy and tabu on the same packet library do not reach under equal evaluation budgets.

steering_directions.direction: Add bounded avalanche dynamics instead of strict monotonic descent
steering_directions.rationale: The canonical frontier is frozen for improving radius-1 and radius-2 moves, so barrier crossing needs coordinated local worsening that is still spatially organized.
steering_directions.first_step: Introduce local activation thresholds, short refractory timers, and a capped burst budget that allows a cluster of neighboring packet nodes to fire together when stagnation persists.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Support briefly expands in a controlled way and then contracts to a better lexicographic objective more often than under simulated annealing using the same packet library.

steering_directions.direction: Use lag-residue or warning-propagation fields only as side information, not as the primary state space
steering_directions.rationale: LABS-style message passing is the strongest adjacent guide for autocorrelation landscapes, but leaving q/s actuation entirely would shift the branch from H1 to H2.
steering_directions.first_step: Compute local lag-field summaries or warning messages and feed them as channels to defect and packet nodes while preserving q/s actuation and identical benchmark accounting.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Packet votes become more coherent, with fewer oscillatory reversals and better median terminal support than the same CA without field channels.

steering_directions.direction: Try a permutation-equivariant graph NCA only after the symbolic graph CA is instrumented
steering_directions.rationale: Learned local rules may discover useful composite coordination patterns, but only if the representation is already genuinely local and transfer is audited.
steering_directions.first_step: Use smaller exact controls and corrupted near-solutions to train a graph NCA on the defect-packet graph, then test transfer to withheld seed families before trying the canonical 668 seed.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The learned rule beats the symbolic CA and matched non-CA baselines on held-out controls before any 668-specific tuning.

steering_directions.direction: Define an explicit no-go pivot criterion for H1
steering_directions.rationale: The most likely failure is fake locality: the CA only rebrands local search or requires increasingly global packets as the objective improves.
steering_directions.first_step: Track changed-lag footprint, touched-edge count, packet scan width, and dependence on global score queries during every run, and stop H1 if these grow toward whole-neighborhood behavior.
steering_directions.expected_signal: If H1 is real, locality metrics stay bounded while performance improves; otherwise the branch is falsified early and H2 becomes the honest next move.

checks: Measure changed-lag support for every candidate packet on the canonical seed and on at least one nearby control; the library should beat the current single-bit baseline by a large margin, including in the upper tail.
Verify that packet evaluation can be updated from local delta tables without rescanning all single-bit packets each step.
Run greedy, tabu, simulated annealing, and the CA on the exact same composite library and budget.
validation_checks.success_signal: A nontrivial fraction of candidate packets are improving or strategically neutral on the canonical seed, and the CA obtains a strict frontier advantage over matched baselines.
validation_checks.failure_signal: The new library only helps because it smuggles in known structure or because greedy and tabu gain the same benefit immediately.

checks: Instrument neighborhood size, message count, and number of packet nodes considered per update; these must stay small relative to the full packet set.
Ablate defect signs, ages, and refractory state separately to see whether the CA uses genuine local memory.
Compare against a score-matched local search that is allowed the same packet library but not the CA state.
validation_checks.success_signal: Removing local memory channels materially hurts performance, and the CA reaches better exact-hit or near-exact statistics without widening the active neighborhood.
validation_checks.failure_signal: The CA trajectory is unchanged after replacing local state with direct global score ranking.

checks: Count controlled worsening bursts and confirm they stay bounded in size and duration.
Measure whether temporary support expansion is followed by better final support and magnitude than the best monotone or annealing baseline.
Audit whether the schedule secretly depends on a global temperature or full objective scan.
validation_checks.success_signal: Short local bursts cross barriers that monotone methods cannot, without degenerating into generic simulated annealing.
validation_checks.failure_signal: Performance only improves when burst size or sensing radius approaches whole-state behavior.

checks: Show that adding lag-field or warning-propagation channels reduces oscillatory packet reversals and improves vote consistency.
Keep actuation in the same q/s packet library so representation control is preserved.
Benchmark the field-augmented CA against a non-CA method given the same side information.
validation_checks.success_signal: Field channels improve the CA more than they improve matched non-CA policies, indicating synergy rather than pure feature engineering.
validation_checks.failure_signal: The same fields make ordinary local search equally strong, implying that the gain comes from the feature map rather than the CA.

checks: Train on solved smaller controls and hold out entire seed families or orders, not just random corruptions from the same instance.
Use permutation-equivariant graph inputs so the model cannot memorize packet IDs.
Compare to a symbolic CA and to non-CA baselines on the same graph and packet library.
validation_checks.success_signal: Transfer to held-out controls appears before any 668-specific tuning, and the model preserves bounded local neighborhoods during rollout.
validation_checks.failure_signal: Performance vanishes under held-out-family testing or depends on seed-specific absolute positions.

checks: Record whether move selection ever requires scanning nearly all packets or recomputing nearly all lag defects.
Track whether packet footprints or active neighborhoods grow as the objective improves.
Reject any run whose strongest results occur only after family leakage into Williamson, Turyn, cocyclic, or micro-solver-driven structured subproblems.
validation_checks.success_signal: The method remains local by instrumentation and still beats matched baselines on the canonical seed or clearly superior controls.
validation_checks.failure_signal: The only winning trajectories are effectively global or structurally leaked, in which case the honest conclusion is that H1 collapses into generic local search or optimizer-over-known-family.

sub_problem: Can a genuinely local defect-syndrome cellular automaton in the q/s packet space of the 64-modular order-668 seed outperform matched non-CA baselines without collapsing into generic local search?
